LanguageData.FB_AcidBroodmother.label: acid broodmother
LanguageData.FB_AcidBroodmother.description: A large fleshbeast that stores acid and spends it to grow temporary acid spitlings. Offspring growth can be enabled or disabled; its acid reserve gradually replenishes.
LanguageData.FB_AcidBroodmother.tools.0.label: heavy maw
LanguageData.FB_AcidSpitling.label: acid spitling
LanguageData.FB_AcidSpitling.description: A temporary offspring of an acid broodmother that bombards enemies with acid. When its acid runs low, it returns to the broodmother to refill.
LanguageData.FB_AcidSpitlingSpitProjectile.label: acid spit projectile
